51002.name: SOUTHWEST HAWAII - 215NM SSW of Hilo, HI

41010.name: CANAVERAL EAST - 120NM East of Cape Canaveral

missing_value_handling: NDBC sentinel values (99, 999, 9999) removed; rows lacking a core wave/weather variable dropped.
limitations: Stations are in the Pacific (Hawaii) and Atlantic (Florida) offshore zones, not Indonesian waters.
Observing cadence is typically 10 minutes with sensor outages; gaps are preserved.
No hazard labels are included. Wave-height percentiles are used only as an evaluation proxy.
Training data are real measurements; CEWS inference inputs in this prototype are simulated.
